comment: 1.30: three waves, slow-focused logarithmic Rate 0.05..3 Hz, named Color and Wave selectors. Original Color categories confirmed; DSP is not a stock clone.

params.name: Rate
params.comment: Exponential curve 0.05*60^(Rate/100), interpolated table. Existing Rate numbers intentionally become slower.

params.name: Color
params.comment: 0=4 normal, 1=8 normal, 2=4 inverted, 3=8 inverted; handler writes raw/100.

params.name: Wave
params.comment: 0=Triangle, 1=Sine, 2=Step; legacy saved code 6 is also treated as Step by DSP. Old 2..5 modes removed.

fxid_comment: 0x060003B3, candidate audited against public stock/community sources; see docs/id-audit.json. No global ID registry exists.
